value.rationale: The single deleted square is a canonical boundary perturbation. The theorem shows a qualitative phase transition between even-by-even extinction, odd-by-odd two-cycles, and mixed-parity only-fixed dynamics with sharp five-step transient and exact probability 1-1/q of maximal entry time. Infinite-family Jordan form and all first-entry counts are mathematically substantive; no claim is made for more deletions.
